description: This file defines the AntlrParser class, a PHP class that extends BaseRecognizer and implements a parser for TokenStreams, including methods for token management, parsing, and tracing.

classes.name: AntlrParser
classes.description: A PHP class for parsing token streams, extending BaseRecognizer, with methods for token handling, parser reset, and tracing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with an input token stream and optional state.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state and rewinds the input stream.

methods.name: getCurrentInputSymbol
methods.description: Returns the current input symbol from the token stream.

methods.name: getMissingSymbol
methods.description: Creates a missing token symbol for error recovery.

methods.name: setTokenStream
methods.description: Sets the input token stream and resets the parser.

methods.name: getTokenStream
methods.description: Returns the current input token stream.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name of the input stream.

methods.name: traceIn
methods.description: Logs entry into a parser rule for tracing.

methods.name: traceOut
methods.description: Logs exit from a parser rule for tracing.
